traits.name: Golem Antimagic
traits.text: harmed by fire (4d8 (4d8), 2d6 (2d6) from areas or persistent damage); healed by plant (area 2d6 (2d6) HP); slowed by earth.

traits.name: Vulnerable to Shape Wood
traits.text: A wood golem targeted by shape wood takes 2d8 (2d8) damage per spell level, with a basic Fortitude save against the caster's spell DC. On a critical failure, the golem is also immobilized for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Splinter
traits.text: ⬲ (arcane, transmutation); Trigger The wood golem takes physical damage; A jagged, sizable splinter of wood lances out at the golem's attacker. The golem makes a splinter Strike against an adjacent creature without triggering reactions.

traits.name: Splinter Volley
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, evocation); The wood golem makes up to four splinter Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the wood golem's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the wood golem makes all of its attacks.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ splinter +16 (magical, range increment 30 feet); Damage 2d4+8 (2d4+8) piercing
